editorial.name: GSAP
editorial.descriptionZh: GreenSock 的 JavaScript 动画库，用来编排 UI、SVG 与 WebGL。核心及插件现按 Webflow Standard No Charge 许可免费商用，禁止给竞品无代码动画搭建器当引擎。
editorial.takeawayZh: 用时间轴编排滚动动画，插件现已免费商用
editorial.noteZh: 我们进去先看首页 Animate Anything，下面把 Scroll、SVG、Text、UI 分成四块。Plugins 页把 ScrollTrigger、SplitText 列成清单。我们打开 ScrollTrigger：一段 pin 和 scrub 就能把滚动钉住。适合要精细编排的人；许可是 Webflow 的 No Charge，不能给无代码动画搭建器当引擎。
editorial.pricing: Free for commercial use under Standard No Charge license

reasons.statement: 首页把 GSAP 定义为面向专业用途的 JavaScript 动画库，用来编排 UI、SVG 与 WebGL，而不是素材包或设计工具。
ScrollTrigger 文档给出 pin、scrub 与独立 create() 示例，证明交付物是可装进项目的滚动动画代码。

Standard License 写 Subject to the terms and conditions of this GSAP License, Webflow grants you a non-exclusive, worldwide license… 页脚 Copyright (©) 2025, Webflow。
Installation 文档链到 GitHub repo https://github.com/greensock/GSAP/ 与 npm 包 gsap。

标题为 Standard “No Charge” GSAP License。FAQ 写 Can I really use GSAP in commercial projects without paying anything? Yes, really! Commercial usage is covered under the standard license. All of GSAP including the plugins that were formerly members-only… can be used in commercial projects at no charge。限制：不得用于与 Webflow 视觉动画搭建器竞争的无代码工具。仓库 package.json 的 license 字段写 Standard 'no charge' license: https://gsap.com/standard-license. 该条款覆盖 GSAP 核心与插件源码，不是 MIT。

facts.value: Free for commercial use under Standard No Charge license
facts.evidence: FAQ 原文：Yes, really! Commercial usage is covered under the standard license. All of GSAP including the plugins that were formerly "members-only" like SplitText and MorphSVG can be used in commercial projects at no charge.
Install Helper 给出 npm install gsap。Installation 写 GSAP and all the plugins are now freely available on npm，并要求使用 3.13 或更高版本。
